run_h2h_pop_sweep: run a head-to-head population sweep by subclassing H2HPopSweep and calling parse_args_and_go
create_agent_derived: create a derived Agent with merged overrides using Agent.create_derived with a new name and overrides dict
build_h2h_pop_item: build an H2HPopItem to evaluate an agent against a Population with optional num_games and exp_tag
launch_eval_and_get_metrics: launch an evaluation and get square_score metrics by calling maybe_launch_and_get_metrics on an H2HPopItem
convert_redefines_dict: convert a dictionary of key-value overrides into a list of key=value strings using redefines_from_dict
